An '''iron spear''' is a [[spear]] of the [[Iron equipment|iron]] tier, crafted from an [[iron ingot]] and two sticks. It is the base for the [[steel spear]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Iron Spear|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Iron Spear|attackspeed}} and has {{Value|Iron Spear|durability}} durability, far more than the [[copper spear]]'s 190. Its charge and jab attacks work as in vanilla.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into a single iron ingot, and at a [[smithing table]] it takes [[steel alloy]] to become its [[Steel equipment|steel]] counterpart.
